description: Search the production and test equipment suppliers listed on Harness Atlas: makers of the machines and test systems wire harnesses are built and checked with (cut & strip, crimping presses and applicators, ultrasonic welding, twisting, seal loading, taping, tube processing, wire marking, electrical harness testing, crimp quality, assembly boards). These are equipment vendors, not harness manufacturers; use find_manufacturer for manufacturers. Filter by equipment category, country, or name. `country` matches the vendor's HQ country or any listed location (service centre, sales office, demo centre, representative). Returns each vendor's categories and its listed locations, each with the public source URL it was taken from.

category.description: Equipment category: 'cut-and-strip' (Cut & strip machines), 'crimping-applicators' (Crimping presses & applicators), 'ultrasonic-welding' (Ultrasonic welding), 'wire-twisting' (Wire twisting machines), 'seal-grommet-loading' (Seal & grommet loading), 'taping-wrapping' (Taping & wrapping machines), 'tube-sleeve-processing' (Tube & sleeve processing), 'marking-labeling' (Wire marking & labeling), 'harness-testing' (Electrical harness testing), 'crimp-quality' (Crimp quality equipment), 'assembly-boards' (Assembly & form boards).

country.description: Country where the vendor is present (HQ or a listed location), e.g. 'Poland', 'Mexico'.

name: search_equipment_suppliers
